title: Add KV-cache miss metrics and token-cost labeling to per-request observability
author: Maya Chen
description: Problem and motivation: customers and SREs have been asking for more granular visibility into per-request cost and latency drivers. Current dashboards show per-request latency and token counts but do not attribute cost or latency to KV-cache behavior (cache hits vs misses) or to token class (prompt vs completion vs system). This makes it hard to tune batching, caching, and quantization tradeoffs or to investigate incidents where cost spikes without obvious throughput increases. This PR introduces schema-level metrics and tagging that let us break down latency and cost by: model, region, kv_cache_hit (true/false), token_type (prompt|completion|system), billing_tier, and request_route. It also adds a set of dashboards and alert adjustments to reduce noisy paging from transient KV misses. Summary of changes: 1) Runtime telemetry: emit two new counter/histogram families: redwood.kv_cache.requests_total{kv_cache_hit=(true|false)} and redwood.request.latency_ms_bucketed with an additional label kv_cache_hit and token_type. 2) Cost tagging: attach estimated token cost label redwood.cost.estimate_usd_per_request (sampled histogram) and redwood.cost.token_usd with labels token_type and model_variant to all generation responses. 3) SDK and API: minor header change so SDKs propagate trace + cost tags end-to-end for hosted and dedicated modes. 4) Dashboards: Grafana dashboard added for KV cache KPI panel, token-cost heatmap by model and region, and a new slow-path investigation panel that slices latencies by kv_cache_hit and token_type. 5) Alerts: tuned the token-cost anomaly alert to use median-of-5m with suppression for short-lived KV miss bursts; added a new alert for sustained KV miss rate > 5% over 10m (ENG-4872). 6) Tests and CI: unit and integration tests for metric labels, and a small e2e smoke harness that verifies the histogram buckets remain stable under high-load synthetic runs. Rollout plan: staged rollout via runtime feature flag enable-kv-cost-metrics: start in staging (2/18), canine lab (perf-canary) for 48h, then 10% prod traffic for 24h, then 100% with a follow-up rollout to add quantization-specific tags if no regressions on cost telemetry (ETA +7 days). Backward compatibility: metrics are additive and default to label kv_cache_hit=unknown in older binaries; no API surface break. Links: Linear ENG-4872, docs PR referencing dashboard JSON (internal link: https://internal.redwood/grafana/dash/kv-cache-kpis). Checklist: - [x] Runtime metric instrumentation added - [x] SDK propagation tested - [x] Grafana panels and JSON exported - [x] Alerts tuned and false-positive tests added - [x] Smoke test in perf-canary: passed
